scope: research-only existing cached Yahoo-derived hourly + daily data
objective: separate post-close reconstruction quality from causal signal eligibility while preserving raw hourly rows
repair_ladder: daily high/low extrema anchor only with complete seven-slot coverage
proportional daily volume reconciliation only with complete coverage and compatible units
single tagged daily-resolution fallback when intraday reconstruction is not defensible

common_scale_rule.factor: median(daily/hourly aggregate ratio for open, high, low, close)
common_scale_rule.reason: fixed data-quality tolerance; not selected on strategy return

volume_rule.reason: conservative same-share-unit compatibility gate already recorded in the pre-return data-quality diagnostic

tiers.A_FULL_RECON_POSTCLOSE: complete coverage + common-scale eligible + price anchors/extrema + compatible proportional volume reconciliation
tiers.B_PRICE_RECON_POSTCLOSE: complete coverage + common-scale eligible + price anchors/extrema; volume remains untrusted
tiers.C_DAILY_RESOLUTION_FALLBACK: valid daily row exists but defensible intraday reconstruction is unavailable; emit exactly one 1D row
tiers.D_UNUSABLE: neither defensible intraday reconstruction nor valid daily fallback

causal_policy.POSTCLOSE_RECON_ONLY: default for rows repaired with same-day finalized daily OHLCV
causal_policy.POSTCLOSE_CAUSAL_OK: allowed only when feature_cutoff_jst >= explicitly supplied daily_final_available_at_jst
causal_policy.RAW_CAUSAL_INTRADAY: pre-close 4H/session features must use raw/cached intraday information available by cutoff plus prior-completed-session calibration only
forbidden: using same-day finalized daily high/low/close/volume before its availability timestamp
duplicating one daily row into fake AM/PM or fake 4H rows

next_research_use: quality tiers may gate/annotate data, but final scoring features remain 4H/intraday-led; daily-only rows are never promoted as final scoring candidates
